title: cryosweep
description: Analysis of Quantum Design PPMS and MPMS measurement files: magnetization (VSM, QD and MPMS formats), AC susceptibility, thermal transport, resistivity, heat capacity and Hall effect. cryosweep detects which measurement a file holds, separates the sweeps, fits the appropriate physical models and reports what it found, including when it cannot report something and why: window-sensitivity ladders on fitted exponents, declines when a parameter pins at a search bound, and integrity warnings on unphysical results. A Qt-free analysis core with a JSON contract, a command-line interface and a PySide6 desktop GUI built on the same analyzers.
